subject: Evaluations: staged access for prompt packs & testcases - MAP and timeline
messages:
From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@oliveanalytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ruiz <j.ruiz@oliveanalytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation materials & MAP — initial share request

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about Redwood's lower-latency serving for our real-time summarization flows. Jordan and I discussed next steps and want to formalize a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can move to a short evaluation with representative prompt packs and test cases. High level ask: a staged exchange of materials (small prompt pack first, then expanded testcases) with defined usage constraints (no redistribution, limited retention).

Can you confirm Redwood's standard MAP timeline for a two-week eval and whether you can provide a scoped prompt pack + 50 test cases under a limited-use license? We'll need the evaluated artifacts to stay on our environment for scoring; if Redwood requires return/removal after the trial, please note that in the MAP. Also attach any template license or redlines we should expect.

We can target a kickoff the week of Nov 2 if that works.

Attachments: "MAP_input_summary.pdf" (brief list of desired test modalities)

Thanks,
Sam Tucker
Head of ML Product
Olive Analytics
sam.tucker@oliveanalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@oliveanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation materials & MAP — initial share request

Sam — great to hear and glad the demo landed. Short answer: yes, we can do a staged MAP and provide a scoped prompt pack + a controlled set of test cases under a limited-use exchange. Outline below is what I propose for a two-week evaluation: 

- Week 0 (kickoff): finalize MAP and sign-lite MSA amendment (we provide NDA copy if needed).
- Week 1: Redwood shares a bounded prompt pack (20 prompts) + 25 canonical test cases — customer runs these in their environment for scoring.
- Week 2: If initial results look good, Redwood releases the expanded pack (additional 30 prompts + 25 edge-case testcases) under the same limited-use license.

Key usage constraints we require in return:
- No public redistribution of Redwood-supplied prompt/test assets.
- Retention limited to the evaluation window unless parties agree in writing.
- No derivative distribution (you can score and report metrics internally).

I attached a draft MAP timeline and a sample redline for the dataset license. Please review and flag anything that would block legal/ops on your side.

Attachments: "MAP_timeline_v3.xlsx", "redline_dataset_license.docx"

If Nov 2 kickoff works, we'll schedule a 30-minute MAP sync on Mon Nov 2 to confirm signers and access mechanism (S3 presigned share or Secure Drive link).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

From: Jordan Ruiz <j.ruiz@oliveanalytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@oliveanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation materials & MAP — initial share request

On Wed, Oct 29, 2026 at 10:08 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sam — great to hear and glad the demo landed. Short answer: yes, we can do a staged MAP and provide a scoped prompt pack + a controlled set of test cases under a limited-use exchange.

Thanks — quick clarifications from our side: 
- We prefer S3 presigned links for the actual artifacts to keep access logs. Is Redwood able to issue time-limited presigned URLs?
- For the retention clause: we can commit to deleting datasets after 30 days post-eval if that's acceptable, but we need the ability to keep anonymized scores/labels for internal product analysis.

Also, we will need a short addendum for compliance folks that says: Redwood will not use Olive's submitted customer data to train models during this evaluation. Can that be included in the MAP?

Sam
Jordan Ruiz
Senior Product Manager
Olive Analytics

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@oliveanalytics.com>, Jordan Ruiz <j.ruiz@oliveanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation materials & MAP — initial share request

Jordan / Sam — thanks for the call today and the clarifications. Quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of agreements:
- Access mechanism: Redwood will provide S3 presigned URLs for each artifact bundle (20 prompts + 25 testcases initially). Links expire after 14 days.
- Retention/derivative: Olive will delete all Redwood-supplied artifacts 30 days after the final evaluation snapshot unless we agree in writing to extend. Olive may retain internal, aggregated metrics/labels but not raw prompt/test files.
- Training restriction: Redwood confirms in the MAP that Olive-owned evaluation inputs will not be used to update Redwood-hosted models or training corpora during or after the trial (included as a one-paragraph addendum in the MAP).
- License: limited-use evaluation license (no redistribution, no derivative distribution). We attached a clean prompt pack for the first wave and an NDA that legal already countersigned.

Attachments sent with this email (zipped to the presigned link): 
- olive_promptpack_v1.zip (20 prompts + README)
- NDA_Olive_signed.pdf
- MAP_timeline_v3.xlsx (updated with signers and dates)

Action items (owners & target dates):
- Marissa: circulate license redline to Olive legal by Wed Nov 11 (Marissa will attach the "redline_dataset_license.docx").
- Karthik: produce access logs for presigned link creation and share to Olive (by Nov 10).
- Sam/Jordan: confirm acceptance of the MAP and sign the small addendum (DocuSign link below) by Fri Nov 13.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/txn/OLV-2026-1593-map-addendum
Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D_olive-eval

If that lines up, we'll provision the presigned links this afternoon and send the DocuSign packet. Please reply with any blockers.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
